summary: Measured the ResNet-20 baseline.
Tried a wider WRN-16-4 with CutMix, cosine LR, label smoothing and higher LR/batch. A large departure from baseline that regressed sharply.
Deepened to ResNet-56 with Cutout, Nesterov and cosine warm restarts, staying close to baseline. Modest gain.
Switched architecture family to PreActResNet-18 with AutoAugment+Cutout and OneCycleLR at batch 256. First big jump.
Tried a wide WRN-16-8 with Cutout, a single cosine cycle and torch.compile (no CutMix/label smoothing). Slightly above prior.
Kept PreActResNet-18 but added CutMix+Mixup switching, SWA and OneCycleLR. Regressed.
Tried a DenseNet-BC architecture with TTA, Cutout, cosine LR and EMA weights. Regressed.
PreActResNet-18 with a single cosine cycle, flip-TTA, gradient clipping and batch 256. New best at the time.
PreActResNet-18 with OneCycleLR super-convergence at batch 512 and EMA weights. Regressed.
PreActResNet-18 with AutoAugment, progressive resizing (24->32) and EMA. Regressed.
PreActResNet-18 with TrivialAugmentWide and a conservative warmup+cosine schedule. Modest.
Switched to ResNeXt-29 (grouped convolutions) with Cutout, conservative cosine and Nesterov. Jumped to 95.7%.
Added flip-based TTA to the PreActResNet-18 recipe plus a higher initial LR. New best.
Added Mixup (alpha=0.2) on top of Cutout+TTA. New best (96.03%).
Added CutMix alongside Mixup (50/50 per batch). Slight regression.
Lowered Mixup alpha to 0.1, added RandomErasing, higher LR and shorter Cutout. Regressed.
Added label smoothing (0.1) to the loss on the proven recipe. Overall winner (96.21%).
Increased weight decay from 5e-4 to 1e-3. Regressed.
Added Stochastic Depth (drop-path 0->0.1) regularization. Slight regression.
Added AutoAugment (CIFAR-10 policy) to the augmentation pipeline. Regressed.
Widened PreActResNet-18 by 1.25x (more channels). Regressed.
Increased batch size to 256 with scaled LR 0.2 and longer warmup. Just below best.
Added an EMA model (decay 0.999) evaluated alongside the live model. Slight regression.
Bugfix: skip integer BatchNorm buffers in the EMA update (the dtype crash). Recovered to 96.03%.
Added 10-crop TTA (center+corners+flips) and raised Mixup alpha to 0.3. Slight regression.
Added Squeeze-and-Excitation attention blocks to PreActResNet-18. Regressed.
Added TrivialAugmentWide as a lighter alternative to AutoAugment. Regressed.
Tightened the cosine schedule (85% margin, longer warmup, lower initial LR 0.08). Slight regression.
Raised LR to 0.15 with a longer warmup, keeping everything else at the winner. Slight regression.
Switched to CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts (2-3 restarts within budget). Regressed.
Added automatic mixed precision (float16) to fit more epochs. Slight regression.
Deepened to PreActResNet-34 with batch 192 to offset the slowdown. Regressed.
Switched to 'correct' CIFAR-10 normalization std instead of (1,1,1). Crashed accuracy (79.5%).
Loosened the cosine schedule safety margin to 95%. Regressed.
Reduced label smoothing from 0.1 to 0.05. Regressed.
Increased Mixup alpha to 0.4 (stronger interpolation). Regressed.
Added bfloat16 mixed precision and full-epoch timing to fit more epochs. Regressed.
Switched optimizer to AdamW (lr 1e-3, wd 0.05). Regressed.
Set Mixup alpha to 0.3 with full-epoch timing. Regressed.
Used heavier 10-crop TTA for the final model only. Regressed.
Timed a full epoch for calibration and decayed cosine to a small non-zero min LR. Regressed.
Re-added EMA (decay 0.9995, every 5 steps, integer buffers handled). Just below best.
Added Dropout (p=0.1) before the final linear layer. Slight regression.
Improved step-time estimation (15 timing steps, 88% margin) for better schedule calibration. Near-best (96.17%).
Used gradient accumulation over 2 batches (effective batch 256) with full-epoch timing. Slight regression.
Switched to LinearLR warmup + CosineAnnealingLR via SequentialLR and raised label smoothing to 0.15. Slight regression.
Swapped custom Cutout for torchvision RandomErasing (random fill). Slight regression.
Added random crop-padding (2-6 instead of fixed 4) for scale diversity. Near-best (96.19%).
Enabled channels-last memory format to speed up convolutions. Just below best.
Calibrated the cosine schedule by timing a full epoch instead of 5 steps. Slight regression.
Built a snapshot ensemble averaging the last 5 low-LR epoch checkpoints. Slight regression.
Skipped the post-warmup model reset (no wasted steps) and used compile mode reduce-overhead. Slight regression.
Reduced Cutout length from 16 to 12. Slight regression.
Increased Cutout length to 20. Regressed.
Lowered weight decay to 3e-4. Near-best (96.10%).
Lowered weight decay to 2e-4 with more warmup/timing steps. Slight regression.
'Best of 2': two independent half-budget runs, returning the better one. Slight regression.
Two independent ~45%-budget runs, returning the better (variance reduction). Regressed.
Reliability pass: more robust timing, no model reset, warmup steps counted in the schedule. Slight regression.
Raised LR to 0.2 with a longer 750-step warmup. Regressed.
Set Mixup alpha to 0.15 (between 0.1 and 0.2). Just below best.
Mixup annealing: Mixup for the first 80% of training, clean data for the last 20%. Slight regression.
Used compile mode reduce-overhead with outlier-trimmed step timing. Slight regression.
Subtracted measured eval time from the budget and applied Mixup with 50% per-batch probability. Slight regression.
Used reflect padding in RandomCrop instead of zero padding. Just below best.
Annealed label smoothing from 0.1 down to 0.0 over training. Slight regression.
Increased Cutout length to 18 with more frequent late-training evaluation. Slight regression.
Deepened slightly to PreActResNet [3,3,3,3] blocks. Regressed.
Added a BN layer after the 1x1 downsampling shortcut conv. Just below best (96.0%).
Raised SGD momentum to 0.95. Regressed.
